Pooling hierarchy

Five worlds is the preferred minimum; fallback removes dimensions from the bottom up.

PvP always separate
1 · Exact segmentPvP × BattlEye × region. Used when at least five eligible worlds share all three dimensions.
2 · Pool regionsIf the exact segment is small, locations are combined while PvP and BattlEye remain fixed.
3 · Pool BattlEyeIf still small, BattlEye cohorts are combined. PvP is never combined with another PvP type.

How to read the signal

What the evidence permits—and what it does not.

Use

Rank worlds by their raw gap to the cross-world mean and act only on the strongest decile outside the friction band.

Do not use

Do not issue a directional call on the common Tibia Coin price level; fifteen model classes fail to beat a random walk.

Binding constraint

Market depth limits deployable size. The opportunity is relative, conditional and capacity-constrained.
